openvex.author: CritterOps maintainers
openvex.role: Repository risk assessment; approval requires pull request review

statements.status_notes: The lint dependency remains vulnerable. Temporary risk acceptance does not assert non-applicability.
statements.action_statement: Restrict linting to trusted repository inputs; monitor the upstream advisory and upgrade the introducing dependency as soon as a patch is available.

exceptions.reason: No patched braces release is available. This dependency is used by development lint tooling; accept its denial-of-service risk temporarily while keeping it out of the deployed production runtime.
exceptions.runtime_exposure: Lint/build tooling can process repository glob patterns. Malicious patterns could terminate tooling. braces is marked dev-only in the npm lockfile, absent from npm ls --omit=dev, and absent from current Next production file traces. Reassess if deployment includes development tooling or untrusted lint inputs.

remediation.details: Official advisory lists <=3.0.3 as affected and no first patched version; npm registry latest is 3.0.3 as of 2026-10-10.

exceptions.follow_up: Recheck GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm and npm releases by 2026-11-09; upgrade the parent dependency when a patch exists, then remove this stale record through pull request review.
evidence: npm explain braces; npm ls braces --omit=dev; Next .next/**/*.nft.json inspection on 2026-10-10
